```{r}
#| include: false
# knitr evaluates inline `r ...` only in a document that has at least one code
# chunk; the Atlas links below are doc_atlas_url() calls (they follow this
# release's host and version), so without this they would print as literal text.
```

This guide walks through the **Atlas**
([`r sub("^https://", "", doc_atlas_url())`](`r doc_atlas_url()`)) one control at a
time. Each numbered step below mirrors a step in the Atlas's built-in **Take a tour**
(click **(?) Help › Take a tour** on a desktop, or **⋯ More › Take a tour** on a phone, to
walk the same path live), with the relevant control highlighted on the screenshot, and links
to open that step's view in the Atlas itself.

For a feature-by-feature reference instead, see the [Atlas](apps/atlas.qmd) chapter
(@sec-app-atlas). The Scores and Species Shiny apps that came before the Atlas have their own,
frozen [step-by-step guide](apps/shiny-guide.qmd) in the Legacy appendix.

::: callout-tip
## How this guide stays in sync

The steps, captions, and highlighted screenshots are generated directly from the Atlas's own
guided tour (the driver.js step data in `src/shell/tour.ts` of the
[`atlas`](https://github.com/MarineSensitivity/atlas) repository). From the atlas repository,
`node scripts/tour-guide.mjs --out <docs>/figures/atlas-guide` walks the tour on a running
build of the Atlas, re-captures a screenshot with each step's control highlighted, and writes
`figures/atlas-guide/steps.json` into this book. So whenever the tour changes, re-running that
one script refreshes this whole page.
:::

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
librarian::shelf(jsonlite, here, quiet = TRUE)

manifest <- here::here("figures", "atlas-guide", "steps.json")
steps    <- if (file.exists(manifest)) jsonlite::read_json(manifest) else list()

# staleness check: is the Atlas tour source newer than the generated manifest?
# MSENS_ATLAS_DIR overrides the sibling checkout (default ../atlas)
atlas_dir <- Sys.getenv(
  "MSENS_ATLAS_DIR",
  unset = normalizePath(file.path(here::here(), "..", "atlas"), mustWork = FALSE))
tour_file <- file.path(atlas_dir, "src", "shell", "tour.ts")
stale     <- file.exists(manifest) && file.exists(tour_file) &&
  file.mtime(tour_file) > file.mtime(manifest)

# releases whose species ids (`sp=` is a v1-v7c `mdl_seq`) are the same numbers: v6, v7,
# v7b and v7c carry the same humpback id; every other release is its own family
# (v1-v5 have no such row, v8/v9 key species by `ms_merge|WORMS:...`)
id_family <- function(ver) {
  if (is.null(ver) || is.na(ver) || !nzchar(ver)) return(NA_character_)
  if (ver %in% c("v6", "v7", "v7b", "v7c")) "v6-v7c" else ver
}

# a step's url is a generic Atlas address for the release it was captured on; rebuild
# it for THIS book's release so a restricted book links the preview host and a public
# one the public host. the species parameters (`sp`, `in`) are model ids that mean
# something only in the capture release's id family, so they are dropped (the step
# opens the lens without a species) unless this book is in that family. falls back
# to the Atlas root if the url has no parseable query.
step_url <- function(u, captured_release = NULL) {
  if (is.null(u) || !nzchar(u)) return(NULL)
  q  <- sub("#.*$", "", sub("^[^?]*\\??", "", u))
  kv <- if (nzchar(q)) strsplit(strsplit(q, "&", fixed = TRUE)[[1]], "=", fixed = TRUE) else list()
  kv <- Filter(function(p) length(p) == 2L && p[1] != "ver", kv)
  same_family <- !is.na(id_family(captured_release)) &&
    identical(id_family(captured_release), id_family(doc_ver()))
  if (!same_family) kv <- Filter(function(p) !p[1] %in% c("sp", "in"), kv)
  args <- stats::setNames(
    lapply(kv, function(p) utils::URLdecode(p[2])),
    vapply(kv, `[`, "", 1L))
  doc_atlas_url(query = args)
}

# provenance line from the manifest's first step (atlas >= 0.10.91 records the build,
# the release shown and the capture date); a plain fallback when they are absent
provenance <- function(steps) {
  s1 <- if (length(steps)) steps[[1]] else list()
  v  <- s1$atlas_version; r <- s1$release; d <- s1$captured
  if (is.null(v) || !nzchar(v)) return(paste(
    "These screenshots were captured from the live Atlas;",
    "the build and capture date are not recorded in this manifest."))
  sprintf("Screenshots captured from the live Atlas %s%s%s.", v,
          if (!is.null(r) && nzchar(r)) sprintf(" (release %s)", r) else "",
          if (!is.null(d) && nzchar(d)) sprintf(" on %s", d) else "")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: guide
#| output: asis
if (length(steps) == 0) {
  cat(
    "::: callout-warning\n",
    "No screenshot manifest found. From the atlas repository, run ",
    "`node scripts/tour-guide.mjs --out <docs>/figures/atlas-guide` ",
    "(needs a running build of the Atlas) to generate ",
    "`figures/atlas-guide/steps.json` and the annotated screenshots.\n",
    ":::\n", sep = "")
} else {
  if (isTRUE(stale)) cat(
    "::: callout-warning\n",
    "The tour in `src/shell/tour.ts` is newer than these screenshots — re-run ",
    "`node scripts/tour-guide.mjs` from the atlas repository to refresh this page.\n",
    ":::\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(provenance(steps), "\n\n", sep = "")

  for (app in unique(vapply(steps, `[[`, "", "app"))) {
    cat(sprintf("\n## %s\n\n", app))
    for (s in Filter(function(x) x$app == app, steps)) {
      cat(sprintf("\n### %d. %s\n\n", s$n, s$title))
      cat(s$text, "\n\n")
      cat(sprintf(
        "![%s](%s){#fig-%s-%02d fig-alt=\"%s\"}\n\n",
        s$title, s$image, s$app_key, s$n,
        gsub('"', "'", sprintf(
          "Step %d: %s — the Atlas with the control it describes highlighted and the tour popover open.",
          s$n, s$title))))
      u <- step_url(s$url, s$release)
      if (!is.null(u)) cat(sprintf("[Open this step in the Atlas](%s)\n\n", u))
    }
  }
}
```
